SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT RC.REQUEST_KEY FROM MSF_REQUEST_CANCEL RC WHERE REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(RC.CANCEL_MOBILE_NO, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g') = #{mobileNo} AND RC.PROC_CD IN ('RQ') /* 확인_ASIS AND (PROC_CD IS NULL OR PROC_CD != 'BK') */ UNION ALL SELECT NC.REQUEST_KEY FROM MSF_REQUEST_NAME_CHG NC INNER JOIN MSF_REQUEST_NAME_TRNS NT ON NT.REQUEST_KEY = NC.REQUEST_KEY WHERE REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(NT.TRNS_MOBILE_NO, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g') = #{mobileNo} AND NC.PROC_CD IN ('RQ') UNION ALL SELECT R.REQUEST_KEY FROM MSF_REQUEST R INNER JOIN MSF_REQUEST_DVC_CHG D ON D.REQUEST_KEY = R.REQUEST_KEY LEFT JOIN MSF_REQUEST_CSTMR C ON C.REQUEST_KEY = R.REQUEST_KEY WHERE R.OPER_TYPE_CD IN ('HCN3', 'HDN3') AND COALESCE(R.PROC_CD, '') = 'RQ' -- 처리결과 (RQ:접수처리중 / RC:처리완료 / BK:접수취소) AND REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(R.OPEN_NO, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g') = #{mobileNo}
) T
